verdict.line: You lose extended trades and all-ins before level 6 while Yorick's Q (Last Rites) sustain and E (Mourning Mist) poke control the lane, but you win from level 6 onward once R (Hextech Ultimatum) lets you force fights on your terms.

brief.thesis: Yorick's E (Mourning Mist, range 700) outranges your W (Tactical Sweep, 610) and far outranges your Q (Precision Protocol, 325), and his Q (Last Rites) heals him back whenever it lands on you, so he wins every poke war before you have an engage tool. Camille only becomes the aggressor once R (Hextech Ultimatum) gives her a hard dash-and-anchor onto him, which is exactly why the measured numbers sit near a coinflip (50.4% over 677 games) despite Yorick holding the lane and solo-kill edge early.

theirWindow.when: before level 6, he's poking at range
theirWindow.what: His E (Mourning Mist) outranges your whole kit and his Q (Last Rites, 6-4s cooldown) heals him on hit. Don't walk up to trade; farm under tower pressure and let your passive (Adaptive Defenses) shield soak the auto he gets instead of initiating.

yourWindow.when: level 6+, once R is off cooldown
yourWindow.what: Dash in with R (Hextech Ultimatum) to anchor him in place, then weave Q (Precision Protocol) empowered auto and W (Tactical Sweep) for the slow and heal. Save E (Hookshot) for when you're near a wall so the knockup actually lands.

start.why: Highest win-rate start into this matchup (51% over 596 games, 71.5% pick) - the lifesteal and AD let you contest short trades even though Yorick's Q sustain outlasts you in a pure poke war.

boots.why: Best-performing boots here (54.3% over 560 games, 76.8% pick) - flat armor dulls both his auto-attacks and the physical hit from Q (Last Rites).

core.why: The spike that actually lets you win fights; completes the power jump the 59.6%-WR build path (161 games) is built around.
Gives you wave clear and sustained damage to out-race his Q (Last Rites) healing once you're forced into a prolonged skirmish.
Converts his damage over time so he can't burst you down before your R (Hextech Ultimatum) cooldown comes back around.

you're ahead and want the ability haste to cycle R (Hextech Ultimatum) and E (Hookshot) faster

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest-performing page for this matchup (53.2% WR, 23.6% pick) - the proc sustains you through his Q (Last Rites) poke and makes close-range autos less costly while you wait for level 6.

summoners.why: The most-played and best-performing pair here (51.6% WR, 66.5% pick) - Flash guarantees your R (Hextech Ultimatum) connects, and Ignite cuts into the healing from his Q (Last Rites) during the all-in.

playing.title: Don't fight at his max range
playing.detail: Yorick's E (Mourning Mist, range 700) outranges your W (Tactical Sweep, 610) and dwarfs your Q (Precision Protocol, 325). If he's poking from max range, disengage and farm instead of walking into it.

playing.title: Punish a whiffed Q
playing.detail: Yorick's Q (Last Rites) is only 6-4s on cooldown, but it has to land on you to heal him. If he misses it on a minion or you, step in for a short trade before it's back up.

playing.title: Respect his wall
playing.detail: Yorick's W (Dark Procession, cooldown 20-12s) drops a destructible wall that can block your approach or seal you into a bad spot. Don't overextend while it's available.

playing.title: Fight near terrain for your hook
playing.detail: Camille's E (Hookshot, range 800) needs a nearby wall to pull off and knock him up. Position skirmishes along lane walls so the tool is actually usable.

playing.title: All-in off your R
playing.detail: At level 6, use R (Hextech Ultimatum, cooldown 140/115/90s) to dash onto Yorick and anchor him before he can kite back or drop a fresh W wall.

playing.title: Weave autos for the shield
playing.detail: Your passive (Adaptive Defenses) shields against physical damage after a basic attack on him. Take short trades specifically to bank this shield before he lands his Q (Last Rites).

playing.title: Target the Maiden post-6
playing.detail: Once Yorick hits R (Eulogy of the Isles), his attacks against the Maiden's target get bonus damage. Focus the Maiden down in fights to cut off that scaling, per the measured matchup tip.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, boots, runes, and summoner picks above come straight from measured games on the current patch (OP.GG); the ability timings and trade-pattern reasoning explaining why those numbers look the way they do are our own tactical read.
